name: ogilvy-plugin
description: Codex plugin for Ogilvy Dominicana branded deliverables (format skills via the stromy-format MCP) and Dominican Republic government-data intelligence (do-gov-data MCP)

interface.shortDescription: Branded deliverables and Dominican Republic government data
interface.longDescription: Produce Ogilvy-branded decks, documents, PDFs, spreadsheets, charts, diagrams and video through the hosted stromy-format renderer, and research Dominican Republic public affairs — procurement, budget execution, both chambers of Congress, consolidated law from 1844, and SCJ and Constitutional Court case law — through the do-gov-data MCP. Brand data ships inside the plugin; the government-data skills are in Spanish and start at do-guide.
defaultPrompt: Build an Ogilvy-branded deck on this topic.
Investiga las licitaciones publicas de esta institucion.
Turn this brief into a branded PDF one-pager.
